blockers.statement: VSPAERO 6.2.0 thin-surface drag at Mach 2.02 on the isolated 12D wing is non-convergent and non-physical (CDi sign flip, negative CDtot, density sensitivity 65x), so VSPAERO cannot provide validated LF drag.

The reproducible RCAIDE single-cruise chain uses VLM induced drag, empirical parasite/compressibility build-up and surrogate interpolation; reproducible does not mean physically validated at Mach 2.02.
The SU2 Euler wedge reproduces wall pressure to 0.42% but misses the pre-declared 1 deg shock-angle tolerance by 1.6-2.1 deg; HFS-00R refinement was not run.
Only two wing mesh levels completed (HFS-01 failed, cap exhausted): medium-to-fine CD changes 4.36%, no order of accuracy or three-level convergence, residual criterion not met.
Euler is inviscid and only the isolated wing is modelled; no fuselage, tail, nacelles, interference or CL-matched LF/HF comparison exists. No full-aircraft high-fidelity claim is allowed.

No calibrated wing-body interference / fuselage correction exists. The Mach-sliced area-rule level for the real geometry is not converged (2.87x under refinement) and contradicts the independent RCAIDE drag level by 2.6-7.4x; the paired increment is retained only as a candidate warning, not a validated correction.

All 23 D-12D-002 starts are consumed (VSPAERO 6/6, RCAIDE 4/4, WAVE 7/7, SU2 6/6); retries and the remaining planned cases (HFS-00R, HFS-04) are NOT_RUN. Further physics requires a new owner approval and budget.
The mission atmosphere yields q = 20654.01 Pa, 0.83% above the frozen 20483.94 Pa; the LF mission results are dimensionalized with the mission q, recorded as a caveat and not silently corrected.

The 12D numeric bounds remain provisional (frozen: false) and the fuselage fixed source, mass and CG are still provisional per the owner's pending decisions; the run used them as stated, not as frozen values.

pass_policy: No gate is approved by this run. APPROVED_FOR_NEXT_STAGE can only be issued by the owner after the owner's pending decisions and a separately approved budget.
